snippet.title: Anymaker Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4435340

Embark on your creative journey of vehicle design, as you create and operate vehicles to navigate this dangerous open world. Anymaker is a detailed and technical vehicle building game. Design your chassis, build your engine, connect components and cables, program controllers, and test performance.
